NP.name: Nepal
NP.law: Motor Vehicles & Transport Management Act 2049 BS

violations.title: Exceeding speed limit by <= 10 km/h (LMV)
violations.statutoryNote: Applicable on marked municipal roads and urban expressways.

violations.title: Exceeding speed limit by 11-20 km/h (LMV)
violations.statutoryNote: Impound license on second repeat.

violations.title: Exceeding speed limit by > 20 km/h (LMV)
violations.statutoryNote: Automated speed-trap camera detection.

violations.title: Speeding in school / hospital safety zone
violations.statutoryNote: Zero tolerance in designated 25 km/h school zones.

violations.title: Heavy vehicle (HMV) exceeding highway speed limit
violations.statutoryNote: Commercial carrier speed governor tamper check required.

violations.title: Two-wheeler exceeding urban speed limit
violations.statutoryNote: Includes e-bikes capable of > 25 km/h.

violations.title: Reckless high-speed drag racing on public streets
violations.statutoryNote: Vehicle impounded for 30 days minimum; mandatory court trial.

violations.title: Repeat street racing within 3 years
violations.statutoryNote: Registration suspended for 1 year; criminal prosecution.

violations.title: Speeding in adverse fog / heavy rain conditions
violations.statutoryNote: Speed must not exceed 40 km/h during low visibility.

violations.title: Speeding while transporting hazardous / explosive cargo
violations.statutoryNote: Petroleum/gas transport tankers subject to special limits.

violations.title: Riding two-wheeler without helmet (Rider)
violations.statutoryNote: Must meet BIS standard IS 4151. 3-month DL suspension on 2nd offence.

violations.title: Riding two-wheeler without helmet (Pillion passenger)
violations.statutoryNote: Section 129 mandates pillion passenger must wear BIS helmet.

violations.title: Wearing unstrapped or broken helmet
violations.statutoryNote: Chinstrap fastening is legally required for valid protection.

violations.title: Using non-certified industrial / construction helmet
violations.statutoryNote: Construction hard hats do not meet motorcycle safety specs.

violations.title: Carrying child below 4 years without child helmet / harness
violations.statutoryNote: Safety harness and speed capped at 40 km/h when carrying child.

violations.title: Triple riding on two-wheeler
violations.statutoryNote: Carrying more than one pillion rider strictly prohibited.

violations.title: Riding with four or more persons on motorcycle
violations.statutoryNote: Gross endangerment of life; vehicle seized.

violations.title: Two-wheeler rider using tinted/blacked visor at night
violations.statutoryNote: Visor light transmission must exceed 85% after dark.

violations.title: Driving four-wheeler without seatbelt (Driver)
violations.statutoryNote: Mandatory three-point inertia reel seatbelt.

violations.title: Front co-passenger not wearing seatbelt
violations.statutoryNote: Driver is accountable for ensuring front passenger compliance.

violations.title: Rear passengers not wearing rear seatbelt
violations.statutoryNote: Enforced nationwide under Central Motor Vehicles Rule 125(1A).

violations.title: Tampering with seatbelt buzzer or dummy clip usage
violations.statutoryNote: Dummy buckle clips confiscated; auto-accessory vendor penalized.

violations.title: Carrying infant in front seat without approved ISOFIX car seat
violations.statutoryNote: Children under 14 or < 135 cm must be secured in child restraint.

violations.title: Operating passenger bus with missing / defective driver seatbelt
violations.statutoryNote: Interstate commercial carrier compliance requirement.

violations.title: Carrying standing passengers in seatbelt-only luxury coach
violations.statutoryNote: Permit violation for national tourist buses.

violations.title: Jumping red traffic signal (Stop line breach)
violations.statutoryNote: E-challan triggered by Automated Red Light Violation Detection (RLVD).

violations.title: Crossing stop line during amber phase when safe stop possible
violations.statutoryNote: Stopping required when amber illuminated unless in intersection.

violations.title: Making illegal right turn at designated No-Right intersection
violations.statutoryNote: Traffic congestion bottleneck hazard.

violations.title: Making illegal U-turn across double white median lines
violations.statutoryNote: Severe side-impact collision risk.

violations.title: Disobeying manual hand signals of on-duty traffic police officer
violations.statutoryNote: Police officer manual signals supersede automated signals.

violations.title: Blocking intersection box junction (Yellow Box gridlock)
violations.statutoryNote: Entering yellow grid without clear exit lane.

violations.title: Failing to give way at roundabout / traffic circle
violations.statutoryNote: Vehicles inside roundabout retain right of way.

violations.title: Failing to stop at railway level crossing red flasher / gate
violations.statutoryNote: Critical disaster prevention section; non-compoundable.

violations.title: Ignoring flashing red beacon signal at high-risk blind crossing
violations.statutoryNote: Full stop required before creeping forward.

violations.title: Disregarding illuminated overhead lane control red X mark
violations.statutoryNote: Lane closed ahead due to maintenance or crash.

violations.title: Driving under influence of alcohol (BAC > 30mg/100ml) - 1st
violations.statutoryNote: Breathalyzer test mandatory; driving license suspended 6 months.

violations.title: Drunk driving repeat offence within 3 years
violations.statutoryNote: Permanent cancellation of driving license; non-bailable court remand.

violations.title: Refusing to undergo breath analyzer / medical sobriety test
violations.statutoryNote: Statutory presumption of intoxication under MV Act Section 203.

violations.title: Commercial / school bus driver under alcohol influence
violations.statutoryNote: Criminal negligence charge; bus operator license scrutinized.

violations.title: Operating heavy machinery / tractor on road while intoxicated
violations.statutoryNote: Equipment impounded until court release order.

violations.title: Driving under influence of narcotics / psychotropic substances
violations.statutoryNote: Blood / urine toxicology lab verification required.

violations.title: Permitting an intoxicated person to drive vehicle in one's charge
violations.statutoryNote: Vehicle owner held jointly culpable.

violations.title: Consuming alcohol inside stationary vehicle in public parking area
violations.statutoryNote: Public nuisance and preparatory offense.

violations.title: Talking on handheld mobile phone while driving
violations.statutoryNote: First offence under dangerous driving clause.

violations.title: Texting / typing on smartphone while vehicle in motion
violations.statutoryNote: Cognitive and visual distraction penalty.

violations.title: Using earphones / noise-canceling headphones while driving
violations.statutoryNote: Auditory isolation blocks ambulance / horn cues.

violations.title: Watching video / streaming content while driving
violations.statutoryNote: Dashboard screen within driver eye-line prohibited.

violations.title: Second offence of mobile phone use within 12 months
violations.statutoryNote: Driving license suspended for 3 months.

violations.title: Live streaming / recording vlog while operating vehicle
violations.statutoryNote: Stunt / distracted endangerment.

violations.title: Commercial transit driver on smartphone while carrying passengers
violations.statutoryNote: City bus, taxi, and auto rickshaw regulation.

violations.title: Operating handheld radio / CB without hands-free kit
violations.statutoryNote: Applies to freight drivers.

violations.title: Driving without a valid driving license
violations.statutoryNote: Cannot be driven until valid licensee arrives.

violations.title: Allowing unauthorized / unlicensed person to drive
violations.statutoryNote: Vehicle owner liable for permitting unlicensed driving.

violations.title: Juvenile / minor driving motor vehicle (Under 18 years)
violations.statutoryNote: Parent/guardian liable to 3 years imprisonment; vehicle RC cancelled 1 yr.

violations.title: Driving with suspended or revoked driving license
violations.statutoryNote: Contempt of statutory transport authority sanction.

violations.title: Driving a vehicle category not endorsed on DL (e.g. HMV on LMV)
violations.statutoryNote: Class mismatch endorsement violation.

violations.title: Driving vehicle without valid Registration Certificate (RC)
violations.statutoryNote: Unregistered vehicle impounded on the spot.

violations.title: Second offence of driving without registration
violations.statutoryNote: Confiscation hearing at Regional Transport Office.

violations.title: Displaying fancy / illegible / tampered number plate
violations.statutoryNote: Must comply with High Security Registration Plate (HSRP) format.

violations.title: Missing or obscured rear registration plate
violations.statutoryNote: Plate must remain illuminated and clearly legible from 20 meters.

violations.title: Driving with forged / stolen registration plate
violations.statutoryNote: Criminal forgery and auto theft investigation.

violations.title: Failure to notify change of residential address on RC within 30 days
violations.statutoryNote: Administrative municipal record update requirement.

violations.title: Expired fitness certificate for commercial transport vehicle
violations.statutoryNote: Vehicle deemed unroadworthy; permit suspended.

violations.title: Driving without valid third-party motor insurance - 1st
violations.statutoryNote: Mandatory third party liability under Section 146.

violations.title: Driving without third-party insurance - 2nd offence
violations.statutoryNote: Impounding of vehicle until valid policy produced.

violations.title: Driving without valid Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate
violations.statutoryNote: Air pollution containment under National Clean Air Programme.

violations.title: Producing fake / forged insurance certificate
violations.statutoryNote: Criminal fraud under Indian Penal Code / BNS.

violations.title: Commercial goods carrier operating without goods-in-transit policy
violations.statutoryNote: Required for inter-state transit permits.

violations.title: Operating passenger transport without passenger liability cover
violations.statutoryNote: High risk to commuter welfare.

violations.title: Tampering with vehicle exhaust / catalytic converter
violations.statutoryNote: Air quality violation; instant PUC cancellation.

violations.title: Visible excessive black smoke emission from diesel exhaust
violations.statutoryNote: Directed to nearest government testing station for dynamometer test.

violations.title: Overloading goods vehicle (Base fine)
violations.statutoryNote: Base fine of ₹20,000 + ₹2,000 per metric tonne of excess load.

violations.title: Refusing to weigh goods vehicle on official weighbridge
violations.statutoryNote: Maximum loading penalty enforced automatically.

violations.title: Offloading excess cargo cost refusal
violations.statutoryNote: Driver/owner must bear unloading and custodial storage costs.

violations.title: Carrying passengers on goods carriage / open truck flatbed
violations.statutoryNote: ₹1,000 per excess passenger carried; offloading mandatory.

violations.title: Carrying excess passengers in passenger bus / auto beyond permit
violations.statutoryNote: Per excess passenger fine; permit violation.

violations.title: Projecting load extending > 1 meter beyond vehicle body (Iron rods)
violations.statutoryNote: Extreme impalement danger; escort required for oversize cargo.

violations.title: Unsecured cargo / loose sand or gravel without tarpaulin cover
violations.statutoryNote: Flying debris danger on highways.

violations.title: Dangerous protruding rods / glass without red flag / hazard lamp
violations.statutoryNote: Must have red safety indicator by day and amber flasher by night.

violations.title: Transporting livestock without partition / veterinary compliance
violations.statutoryNote: Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Transport) Rules.

violations.title: School bus carrying students beyond certified seated capacity
violations.statutoryNote: ₹2,000 per extra child; school transport safety auditor notification.

violations.title: Illegal parking on marked yellow curb / No Parking zone
violations.statutoryNote: Wheel clamp applied; municipal towing fee extra.

violations.title: Parking within 10 meters of a road junction / intersection
violations.statutoryNote: Blocks sightlines for oncoming cross-traffic.

violations.title: Parking at or blocking designated bus stop / BRTS lane
violations.statutoryNote: Impairs public mass transit efficiency.

violations.title: Parking on sidewalk / pedestrian footpath
violations.statutoryNote: Forces pedestrians into vehicular traffic lane.

violations.title: Parking in designated handicapped / disabled bay without badge
violations.statutoryNote: Violation of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act.

violations.title: Parking directly in front of emergency fire hydrant
violations.statutoryNote: Immediate tow-away; municipal emergency obstruction.

violations.title: Abandoning broken vehicle on highway without reflective triangles
violations.statutoryNote: Must place hazard triangles 50 meters behind vehicle.

violations.title: Double parking creating blockage in active traffic lane
violations.statutoryNote: Towed to nearest municipal impound yard.

violations.title: Parking on bridge, flyover, underpass or railway subway
violations.statutoryNote: Critical choke point; zero tolerance zone.

violations.title: Parking against flow of traffic (Wrong side curbside)
violations.statutoryNote: Headlights cause disorientation on pullout.

violations.title: Driving on wrong side of divided road / one-way street
violations.statutoryNote: Head-on collision danger; non-compoundable on 2nd offence.

violations.title: Zig-zag / serpentine aggressive weaving through traffic
violations.statutoryNote: Endangerment of surrounding motorists.

violations.title: Tailgating / failing to maintain safe following distance
violations.statutoryNote: Minimum 2-second gap rule violated.

violations.title: Overtaking from left (near side) without legal exception
violations.statutoryNote: Overtaking must be conducted on right side in RHD jurisdictions.

violations.title: Overtaking on blind curve, hill crest, or zebra crossing
violations.statutoryNote: Sight distance inadequate for safe pass.

violations.title: Driving on pedestrian zebra crossing when pedestrians are waiting
violations.statutoryNote: Pedestrian right of way paramount at zebra markings.

violations.title: Reversing into highway from ramp or shoulder
violations.statutoryNote: Extreme risk of high-speed rear impact.

violations.title: Straddling lane dividing line (Continuous center riding)
violations.statutoryNote: Obstructs adjacent lane traffic.

violations.title: Entering dedicated BRTS bus rapid transit corridor
violations.statutoryNote: Bhopal / Indore BRTS dedicated corridor breach.

violations.title: Crossing solid double white center line
violations.statutoryNote: Strict prohibition on overtaking where double solid lines painted.

violations.title: Failing to dim high beams when approaching oncoming vehicle
violations.statutoryNote: Glaring hazard causing temporary blindness.

violations.title: Using blinding aftermarket LED light bars / strobe lamps
violations.statutoryNote: Illegal lights confiscated and removed on the spot.

violations.title: Failing to draw to curb to allow ambulance to pass
violations.statutoryNote: Life-threatening obstruction; non-compoundable prosecution.

violations.title: Failing to yield right of way to fire tender / rescue vehicle
violations.statutoryNote: Disaster response delay penalty under Section 194E.

violations.title: Failing to give way to police emergency response squad (112)
violations.statutoryNote: Law enforcement tactical obstruction.

violations.title: Following ambulance closely to evade traffic signals
violations.statutoryNote: Reckless exploitation of emergency convoy corridor.

violations.title: Using fake emergency sirens or flashing red/blue beacons
violations.statutoryNote: Impersonating emergency authority vehicle.

violations.title: Using multi-toned / musical / high-decibel pressure horns
violations.statutoryNote: Air pressure horn confiscated immediately.

violations.title: Honking in designated Silent Zone (Hospitals, Courts)
violations.statutoryNote: First offence in marked silent zone.

violations.title: Repeat honking in silent zone within 12 months
violations.statutoryNote: Second offence; noise abatement fine doubled.

violations.title: Fitting modified loud exhaust (Free-flow / decibel > 80dB)
violations.statutoryNote: Motorcycle silencer noise must comply with AIS-058.

violations.title: Causing backfire / cracker popping sounds through engine cutoff
violations.statutoryNote: Public panic and sonic nuisance penalty.

violations.title: Unauthorized structural modification (Limo cut, wheel spacers)
violations.statutoryNote: ₹1,00,000 fine on vehicle modifier; registration cancelled.

violations.title: Deep tint sun film with < 70% front/rear or < 50% side VLT
violations.statutoryNote: Supreme Court mandate; film scraped off at inspection kiosk.

violations.title: Installing aftermarket bull bars / metal crash guards on front
violations.statutoryNote: Impedes airbag deployment sensor and endangers pedestrians.

violations.title: Blaring exterior PA system or DJ speaker without permit
violations.statutoryNote: Sound equipment impounded under Noise Pollution Rules.

violations.title: Spilling engine oil / coolant on public roadway without warning
violations.statutoryNote: Skid hazard for two-wheelers.

violations.title: Operating commercial vehicle without valid route permit
violations.statutoryNote: Vehicle seized; application to State Transport Authority required.

violations.title: Operating vehicle in contravention of permit conditions
violations.statutoryNote: Unauthorized detour or unchartered passenger pickup.

violations.title: Auto rickshaw / taxi driver refusing passenger without cause
violations.statutoryNote: Mandatory service refusal penalty.

violations.title: Auto rickshaw / taxi overcharging beyond approved meter fare
violations.statutoryNote: Fare meter recalibration inspection ordered.

violations.title: Operating taxi / auto without functioning electronic fare meter
violations.statutoryNote: Meter seal broken or uncalibrated.

violations.title: Allowing unauthorized advertising banner obscuring driver vision
violations.statutoryNote: Municipal civic display guidelines violation.

violations.title: Bus conductor collecting fares without issuing valid ticket
violations.statutoryNote: Fare theft from municipal transit authority.

violations.title: Passenger traveling on public bus without valid ticket
violations.statutoryNote: Ticketless travel fine plus fare for entire route length.

violations.title: Permitting passenger to travel on roof, ladder or side step
violations.statutoryNote: Catastrophic fall risk; driver prosecuted.

violations.title: Operating app-based aggregator fleet without municipal license
violations.statutoryNote: Aggregator compliance rule under Section 93.

violations.title: Failing to stop and assist injured person after an accident
violations.statutoryNote: Duty to render medical help and report to police within 24 hours.

violations.title: Hit-and-run resulting in severe grievous bodily injury
violations.statutoryNote: Non-bailable warrant; Solomon fund compensation invoked.

violations.title: Hit-and-run resulting in death of victim
violations.statutoryNote: Culmination of rash & negligent driving causing death (304A IPC/BNS).

violations.title: Failing to report collision damaging public property / railings
violations.statutoryNote: Municipal repair compensation cost assessed.

violations.title: Misleading investigating officer by giving false crash report
violations.statutoryNote: Obstruction of justice.

violations.title: Fleeing police checkpost / checkpoint inspection
violations.statutoryNote: Evading lawful police command; vehicle flagged statewide.

violations.title: Tampering with accident vehicle evidence prior to inspection
violations.statutoryNote: Mechanical inspection must precede any body repair.

violations.title: Failing to provide insurance details to accident victims
violations.statutoryNote: Required for Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT) claim.

violations.title: Operating vehicle with defective / non-functional headlights
violations.statutoryNote: Nighttime road illumination failure.

violations.title: Driving with non-functional brake lamps / rear indicators
violations.statutoryNote: Prevents trailing motorists from anticipating deceleration.

violations.title: Driving with bald / dangerously worn tires (Tread < 1.6mm)
violations.statutoryNote: Hydroplaning and puncture rollover danger.

violations.title: Defective braking system on commercial freight carrier
violations.statutoryNote: Immediate road suspension until brake test passed.

violations.title: Missing rear-view mirrors (Left and right side mirrors)
violations.statutoryNote: Mandatory blind spot visibility equipment.

violations.title: Defective horn or non-functional warning equipment
violations.statutoryNote: Basic auditory warning required.

violations.title: Missing emergency exit / hammer on interstate passenger bus
violations.statutoryNote: Passenger safety non-compliance.

violations.title: Missing or expired fire extinguisher in commercial vehicle
violations.statutoryNote: Mandatory ABC powder fire extinguisher in cab.

violations.title: Cracked windshield obscuring driver direct forward vision
violations.statutoryNote: Structural integrity of laminated windshield compromised.

violations.title: Missing mudguards or spray suppression flaps on heavy truck
violations.statutoryNote: Sprays mud and gravel into trailing windscreens.

violations.title: Failing to stop for pedestrians crossing on zebra crossing
violations.statutoryNote: Pedestrian safety priority zone.

violations.title: Driving or parking on dedicated bicycle lane / cycle track
violations.statutoryNote: Encroachment on green non-motorized transport corridor.

violations.title: Opening vehicle door into cyclist or passing traffic (Dooring)
violations.statutoryNote: Dutch reach standard encouraged to avoid dooring crashes.

violations.title: Splashing muddy rainwater deliberately onto pedestrians
violations.statutoryNote: Uncivil civic conduct penalty.

violations.title: Harassing or intimidating cyclists by close-passing (< 1.5m)
violations.statutoryNote: Safe overtaking buffer distance breached.

violations.title: Failing to assist visually impaired pedestrian with white cane
violations.statutoryNote: White cane signals immediate right of way across all lanes.

violations.title: Blocking curb-cut ramp designed for wheelchair accessibility
violations.statutoryNote: Denial of universally accessible pedestrian infrastructure.

violations.title: Riding motorized scooter on designated pedestrian-only promenade
violations.statutoryNote: MP Nagar / New Market pedestrian plazas.
